added: Added Antigravity Manager support to Quota Viewer, displaying saved account quota snapshots, account status, grouped or per-model quotas, and reset times. Refresh rereads snapshots without triggering a refresh in the manager.
changed: Unified CPA quota sources: one connection automatically discovers Codex and Devin accounts, while disabled, unsupported, and failed accounts remain visible with status information. Legacy Codex/Devin sources migrate automatically, merging legacy entries with the same management URL and key.

Redesigned Quota Viewer with consistent account rows, compact core quota bars and reset times, Codex reset counts beside the plan, and expandable supplementary details. Visibility preferences are grouped by quota type and shared across sources of that type.
Failed account quota queries now retain previous results and snapshot timestamps, with visible error status and details.
Disabled double-click resizing on workbench, session-column, terminal, and project-view dividers.
Updated website installation commands to omit explicit package versions and tags, clarified that npx may reuse a cached version, and added guidance about npm mirror synchronization delays.
fixed: Prevented a blank Windows installer window from appearing while the application launches after installation completes.
